Combination of Lenses — Quick Reference

Key Formulas / Values

1/f = 1/f1 + 1/f2 for two lenses in contact, 1/F = 1/f1 + 1/f2 - d/f1f2 for two lenses separated by distance d, f = (f1 * f2) / (f1 + f2 - d) for combination of two lenses in air.

Mnemonics

For combination of lenses, sign convention is must to remember, for convex lens +ve and concave lens -ve, object distance -ve for virtual object and +ve for real object. Thin lens formula 1/f = 1/v - 1/u should be on tips.

Key Points

  • Two or more lenses in contact are replaced by a single lens of focal length given by formula.
  • When two lenses are separated by a certain distance the equivalent focal length is given by the formula.
  • Sign convention must be followed for deriving lens formula.
  • For real image, image distance is +ve and for virtual image, image distance is -ve.
